body:
> 1.2.1 Verify the use of unique or special low-privilege operating system accounts for all application components, services, and servers.

In my opinion this is configuration (or maybe Access Control) but not Authentication.

> Verify that communications between application components, including APIs, middleware and data layers, are authenticated with the least necessary privileges.

This sounds like the focus was on least privilege, which is Authorization/Access Control and not Authentication.

How about splitting this into 2 Controls:

- Authentication: Verify that communications between application components, including APIs, middleware and data layers, are authenticated.
- Access Control: Verify that communications between application components, including APIs, middleware and data layers, are performed with individual users with the least necessary privileges.
